title: Growing Cardiopulmonary Challenge: National Mortality Trends of Pulmonary Vascular Disease and Atrial Fibrillation In the United States
Heart failure and atrial fibrillation prediction from non-gated chest CT scans using AI-based cardiac chamber volumetry: an AI-CVD study within the multi-ethnic study of atherosclerosis (MESA).
summary:
BACKGROUND: We previously demonstrated that AI-derived cardiac chamber volumetry in ECG-gated CT scans predicts atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF). Since most chest CTs are non-gated, and the American Heart Association recently highlighted their value for opportunistic cardiovascular risk assessment using AI-based coronary artery calcium scoring, we extended this concept to evaluate whether AI-derived chamber volumetry from non-gated CTs can reliably predict HF and AF.s.

METHODS: We compared AI-derived chamber volumetry from non-gated and ECG-gated chest CTs in 2053 Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) Exam 5 participants using mean and standard-deviation of absolute differences, intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC), and Cohen's κ. Variability between paired ECG-gated scans was determined by analyzing scans acquired 2 min apart in 5749 MESA Exam 1 participants. Predictive performance for incident HF and AF was compared using cumulative incidence curves, age- and sex-adjusted C-indices, and non-inferiority testing (δ=0.05).

RESULTS: Non-gated scans demonstrated excellent overall agreement with ECG-gated scans, with comparable performance for detecting cardiac chamber enlargement (98.8-99.2%, κ=0.76-0.84), relative to agreement observed between paired ECG-gated scans (98.6-98.9%, κ=0.72-0.77). Cumulative incidence curves for HF and AF stratified by quartiles showed substantial overlap. Age- and sex-adjusted C-indices were comparable for left atrial volume (0.75 vs 0.74, p = 0.001, non-inferiority p < 0.001), ventricular volume (both 0.77, p = 0.97, non-inferiority p < 0.001), and ventricular ratio (both 0.74, p = 0.57, non-inferiority p < 0.001) in predicting AF and HF.

CONCLUSION: AI-based evaluation of non-gated chest CT may provide reliable cardiac chamber volumetry and cardiovascular outcome prediction, enabling opportunistic screening for HF and AF risk.

AI.tldr: 基于AI的非门控胸部CT心脏腔室容积测量与门控CT高度一致，对心衰和房颤的预测性能非劣效，可用于机会性筛查。
AI.motivation: 既往研究证实AI可从心电图门控CT中提取心脏腔室容积预测房颤和心衰，但多数胸部CT为非门控扫描，且美国心脏协会近期强调其用于机会性心血管风险评估的价值，因此需验证非门控CT的预测可靠性。
AI.method: 在MESA研究Exam 5的2053名参与者中，比较AI提取的非门控与门控CT腔室容积，采用绝对差异均值与标准差、组内相关系数（ICC）和Cohen's κ评估一致性；以Exam 1中5749名参与者间隔2分钟的门控扫描配对分析确定变异性。通过累积发生率曲线、年龄性别调整C指数和非劣效性检验（δ=0.05）比较对 incident HF 和AF的预测性能。
AI.result: 非门控与门控CT总体一致性优秀，检测心脏腔室扩大的性能相当（98.8-99.2%，κ=0.76-0.84），与配对门控扫描间一致性（98.6-98.9%，κ=0.72-0.77）相似。按四分位分层的HF和AF累积发生率曲线大幅重叠。年龄性别调整C指数：左房容积预测AF为0.75 vs 0.74（p=0.001，非劣效性p<0.001），心室容积预测HF均为0.77（p=0.97，非劣效性p<0.001），心室比值均为0.74（p=0.57，非劣效性p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: AI评估非门控胸部CT可提供可靠的心脏腔室容积测量和心血管结局预测，支持其用于心衰和房颤风险的机会性筛查；但需外部验证，且摘要未报告具体临床实施细节。

背景：我们先前已证明，ECG门控CT扫描中AI导出的心腔容积测量可预测心房颤动（AF）和心力衰竭（HF）。由于大多数胸部CT是非门控的，且美国心脏协会最近强调了其在使用基于AI的冠状动脉钙化评分进行机会性心血管风险评估中的价值，我们将这一概念扩展，以评估非门控CT中AI导出的心腔容积测量是否能可靠预测HF和AF。

方法：我们在2053名多民族动脉粥样硬化研究（MESA）第5次检查参与者中，使用绝对差异的均值和标准差、组内相关系数（ICC）和Cohen's κ，比较了非门控和ECG门控胸部CT中AI导出的心腔容积测量。配对ECG门控扫描之间的变异性通过分析5749名MESA第1次检查参与者间隔2分钟采集的扫描来确定。使用累积发病率曲线、年龄和性别调整的C指数以及非劣效性检验（δ=0.05）比较了对新发HF和AF的预测性能。

结论：基于AI的非门控胸部CT评估可能提供可靠的心腔容积测量和心血管结局预测，从而实现HF和AF风险的机会性筛查。

title: Determinants of outcome in atrial functional tricuspid regurgitation
summary: BACKGROUND: Atrial functional tricuspid regurgitation (AFTR) is increasingly recognized as a result of atrial remodelling in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). However, prognostic predictors in this population remain incompletely defined. OBJECTIVES: To evaluate echocardiographic characteristics and identify predictors of all-cause mortality in patients with AFTR. METHODS: . Patients with at least moderate functional tricuspid regurgitation comprised the AFTR cohort, while patients with mild/trivial/no tricuspid regurgitation served as controls. Patients with primary valvular disease, cardiomyopathy, congenital heart disease, device-related valve disease, RV dilatation, or more than mild RV systolic dysfunction were excluded. Cox proportional hazards regression was performed to identify predictors of mortality. RESULTS: A total of 152 patients were included, comprising 120 patients with AFTR and 32 controls. Compared with controls, patients with AFTR demonstrated larger atrial dimensions, higher right-sided hemodynamic-burden, impaired RV longitudinal strain, and reduced reservoir RA strain. During a median follow-up of 6.3 years, 53 deaths (45%) occurred among patients with AFTR. In univariable Cox analysis, age (HR 1.02, 95% CI 1.00-1.04; p = 0.016), TR Vmax (HR 1.59, 95% CI 1.07-2.35; p = 0.020), and lower reservoir RA strain (HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.84-0.96; p = 0.003) were associated with mortality. In multivariable analysis, reservoir RA strain remained independently associated with mortality (adjusted HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.81-0.95; p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: AFTR is characterized by marked biatrial remodelling and impaired right atrial function. Reduced RA reservoir strain was independently associated with mortality, supporting a potential role for RA deformation imaging in risk stratification in AFTR.

AI.tldr: 在房颤相关功能性三尖瓣反流患者中，右房储器应变降低是全因死亡的独立预测因素（校正HR 0.88，95%CI 0.81-0.95，P<0.001）。
AI.motivation: 房颤相关功能性三尖瓣反流（AFTR）日益被认为是房颤患者心房重构的结果，但该人群的预后预测因素尚未完全明确，需要识别可用于风险分层的影像学指标。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入至少中度功能性三尖瓣反流的AFTR患者120例，以轻度/微量/无三尖瓣反流患者32例为对照；排除原发性瓣膜病、心肌病、先天性心脏病、器械相关瓣膜病、右室扩大或右室收缩功能不全超过轻度者。采用Cox比例风险回归分析全因死亡的预测因素。
AI.result: 中位随访6.3年，AFTR组53例（45%）死亡。单因素Cox分析显示年龄（HR 1.02，95%CI 1.00-1.04，P=0.016）、三尖瓣反流最大速度（HR 1.59，95%CI 1.07-2.35，P=0.020）和较低的右房储器应变（HR 0.90，95%CI 0.84-0.96，P=0.003）与死亡相关；多因素分析中右房储器应变仍为独立预测因素（校正HR 0.88，95%CI 0.81-0.95，P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: AFTR以显著的双心房重构和右房功能受损为特征，右房储器应变降低与全因死亡独立相关，提示右房形变成像可能有助于AFTR的风险分层；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限，结论需前瞻性验证。

title: GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are potent risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet whether GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) prevent incident AF in non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD is unexamined. We assessed whether GLP-1RA therapy reduces 1-year AF incidence in this cardiorenal phenotype.

METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network (66 healthcare organizations), we conducted a retrospective target trial emulation of non-diabetic adults aged 18 or older with obesity and CKD stages 3-5 diagnosed 2021-2024. Patients receiving semaglutide, liraglutide, or tirzepatide (n = 10,985) were compared with unexposed patients (n = 94,527). After propensity score matching, 7326 patients remained per cohort. The primary outcome was incident AF at 1 year; secondary outcomes included AF subtypes, ventricular tachyarrhythmias, and all-cause hospitalization. Cox models generated hazard ratios (HRs); sensitivity analyses extended follow-up to 2-3 years with landmark analyses.

RESULTS: At 1 year, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower incident AF (1.63% vs. 2.62%; HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001), a 34.5% relative risk reduction. Reductions were consistent for paroxysmal (HR 0.586), persistent (HR 0.482), and longstanding persistent AF (HR 0.527; all p < 0.05); permanent AF was non-significant at 1 year. Ventricular tachyarrhythmias (HR 0.556; p = 0.002) and hospitalization (HR 0.668; p < 0.001) were also significantly reduced. Benefits persisted across 2- and 3-year follow-up and remained consistent in landmark analyses.

CONCLUSIONS: In non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD, GLP-1RA therapy was associated with significant, durable reductions in incident AF, ventricular arrhythmias, and hospitalization. These findings are consistent with a possible cardiorenal benefit and support prioritizing this phenotype for dedicated randomized trials.

AI.tldr: 在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中，GLP-1RA治疗与1年新发AF风险降低34.5%相关，且持续至3年。
AI.motivation: 肥胖和慢性肾脏病（CKD）是房颤（AF）的重要危险因素，但GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）能否在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中预防新发AF尚未被研究。本研究旨在评估GLP-1RA治疗是否降低该心肾表型人群的1年AF发生率。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX美国协作网络（66家医疗机构）的回顾性目标试验模拟，纳入2021-2024年诊断为肥胖和CKD 3-5期的非糖尿病成人（≥18岁）。暴露组接受司美格鲁肽、利拉鲁肽或替尔泊肽（n=10,985），对照组为未暴露患者（n=94,527）。倾向性评分匹配后每组各7,326例。主要终点为1年新发AF；次要终点包括AF亚型、室性快速性心律失常和全因住院。采用Cox模型计算风险比（HR），并进行敏感性分析（随访延长至2-3年及landmark分析）。
AI.result: 1年时，GLP-1RA组新发AF发生率显著低于对照组（1.63% vs. 2.62%；HR 0.655，95% CI 0.508-0.844；p=0.001），相对风险降低34.5%。阵发性（HR 0.586）、持续性（HR 0.482）和长程持续性AF（HR 0.527）风险均显著降低（均p<0.05）；永久性AF在1年时无统计学意义。室性快速性心律失常（HR 0.556；p=0.002）和住院（HR 0.668；p<0.001）也显著减少。获益在2年和3年随访及landmark分析中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中，GLP-1RA治疗与1年新发AF、室性心律失常和住院风险显著且持久降低相关。这些发现提示可能的心肾获益，支持将该表型人群优先纳入专门的随机对照试验。

title: Artificial intelligence versus conventional risk scores for predicting incident atrial fibrillation: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
summary: Full protocol (version 1.2) for a systematic review and meta-analysis comparing the discrimination, calibration and incremental value of artificial intelligence-based models (AI-ECG, machine learning on electronic health records) with conventional risk scores (CHARGE-AF, C2HEST, CHA2DS2-VASc) for predicting incident atrial fibrillation in adults. Includes the search strategy and statistical analysis plan, including pairwise and network meta-analysis of C-statistics. Review start date: 1 September 2026; expected completion: 20 November 2026. Prospectively registered: at registration only pilot work (preliminary searches) had been done; the formal search, screening, data extraction and synthesis had not started. PROSPERO registration in preparation.

AI.tldr: 本研究方案拟系统评价与荟萃分析，比较人工智能模型与传统风险评分对成人新发房颤的预测区分度、校准度及增量价值。
AI.motivation: 房颤预测中，AI模型（如AI-ECG、基于电子健康记录的机器学习）与CHARGE-AF、C2CHEST、CHA2DS2-VASc等传统评分的预测性能孰优孰劣尚缺乏系统比较证据，需通过系统评价与荟萃分析明确其区分度、校准度及增量价值。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析方案（版本1.2），纳入成人新发房颤预测研究，比较AI模型与传统风险评分。主要终点为区分度（C统计量）、校准度及增量价值。计划进行成对及网状荟萃分析C统计量。检索策略与统计分析计划已制定，正式检索、筛选、数据提取与合成尚未开始。预计2026年9月1日开始，2026年11月20日完成。PROSPERO注册准备中。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何研究结果，因该文为研究方案，正式检索与数据合成尚未开始。
AI.conclusion: 该方案将首次系统比较AI模型与传统风险评分对新发房颤的预测性能，结果可能为临床选择预测工具提供依据，但研究尚未实施，结论待定。

title: Projected Failure Margins in Biological Chaos: Cardiac Arrhythmias and Neural Dynamics as Thickening
summary: This paper applies the reachability framework of Doucette (2026a) to biological chaos-control results reported in the Handbook of Chaos Control, asking whether the handbook's successes can be read as restorations of a positive distance between a projected reachable set and a failure set. The author distinguishes local instability from operational consequence: a continuous projection maps the state space onto low-dimensional observables, and a closed failure set marks forbidden regions. Instability is called thin when the projected reachable set stays at positive distance from failure, thick when instability participates in transport that meets failure, and transitional when the distance remains positive but shrinks. For cardiac preparations, the projection is taken to be the sequence of inter-beat intervals, with failure defined as intervals shorter than a conduction-block threshold or longer than a threshold associated with loss of mechanical coordination. For neural models, the projection extracts local field-potential amplitude or a coherence index, with failure defined as sustained hypersynchrony. The paper's central proposition states that a positive uncontrolled margin survives sufficiently small feedback applied only in a buffer zone adjacent to the failure set, provided the perturbation's effect on the return map is bounded relative to the margin. The rabbit ventricular and human atrial fibrillation experiments are then read as margin restoration: uncontrolled intervals approach short-interval failure values, while captured segments collapse onto orbits bounded away from failure. The neural stabilization results satisfy the same geometry. Factors such as increased dispersion of refractoriness, failure of local linearization, elevated extracellular potassium, and stronger synaptic coupling are described as enlarging the projected reachable set toward failure. The author explicitly limits the claims, noting that delay-coordinate reconstruction may distort distances, local stimuli leave other tissue unaffected, physiological parameters drift, and failure thresholds are empirical clinical choices. The account introduces no new measurements and asserts no clinical advantage; it merely renders the handbook results comparable under a single explicit margin criterion.

AI.tldr: 该文将可达性框架应用于生物混沌控制，以心搏间期投影定义失败集，提出正的无控制裕量在缓冲带反馈下得以保持，但未提供新数据或临床优势。
AI.motivation: 旨在检验《混沌控制手册》中生物混沌控制成功案例是否可解读为投影可达集与失败集之间正距离的恢复，以统一框架比较不同实验结果，解决缺乏明确裕量标准的问题。
AI.method: 理论分析文章，无新测量。对心脏制备以心搏间期序列为投影，失败定义为间期短于传导阻滞阈值或长于机械协调丧失阈值；对神经模型以局部场电位幅度或相干指数为投影，失败定义为持续超同步。提出中心命题：若扰动对回归映射的影响相对于裕量有界，则仅在失败集邻近缓冲带施加足够小反馈可保持正的无控制裕量。
AI.result: 将兔心室和人心房颤动实验解读为裕量恢复：无控制间期接近短间期失败值，捕获段坍缩至远离失败的轨道；神经稳定结果满足相同几何。未报告具体效应量、置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使手册结果在单一显式裕量标准下可比，但作者明确限制：延迟坐标重建可能扭曲距离、局部刺激不影响其他组织、生理参数漂移、失败阈值属经验临床选择；未引入新测量，未声称临床优势，对电生理实践的影响有限。

summary_zh: 本文应用Doucette（2026a）的可达性框架，对《混沌控制手册》中报道的生物混沌控制结果进行分析，探讨手册中的成功案例是否可解读为投影可达集与失败集之间正距离的恢复。作者区分了局部不稳定性与操作性后果：连续投影将状态空间映射到低维可观测量上，而闭失败集标记了禁止区域。当投影可达集与失败集保持正距离时，不稳定性被称为“薄”；当不稳定性参与到达失败集的输运时，称为“厚”；当距离保持为正但缩小时，称为“过渡性”。对于心脏标本，投影取为心搏间期序列，失败定义为间期短于传导阻滞阈值或长于与机械协调丧失相关的阈值。对于神经模型，投影提取局部场电位幅度或相干性指数，失败定义为持续的超同步。本文的核心命题指出，只要扰动对回归映射的影响相对于裕度有界，仅施加在邻近失败集的缓冲区内足够小的反馈即可使正的无控制裕度得以保留。随后，兔心室和人心房颤动实验被解读为裕度恢复：无控制间期接近短间期失败值，而捕获段则坍缩到远离失败的有界轨道上。神经稳定化结果满足相同的几何结构。诸如不应期离散度增加、局部线性化失效、细胞外钾升高以及突触耦合增强等因素被描述为将投影可达集向失败集扩大。作者明确限制了其主张，指出延迟坐标重构可能扭曲距离，局部刺激不影响其他组织，生理参数漂移，且失败阈值是经验性的临床选择。本论述未引入新的测量，也未主张任何临床优势；它仅仅使手册中的结果在单一明确的裕度标准下具有可比性。

title: Recurrent Supraventricular Tachycardia Triggered by Tea Consumption in a Postoperative Adolescent Female: A Case Report.
summary: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) in adolescents may be triggered by physiological stress or caffeine. We report a 16-year-old girl who complained of palpitations, dyspnea, and regular tachycardia (170 beats/min) after tea intake. ECG showed SVT and intravenous adenosine restored sinus rhythm. Recognizing dietary stimulants as potential precipitants of SVT is important.

AI.tldr: 一例16岁术后女性饮茶后反复发作室上性心动过速（心率170次/分），静脉腺苷可恢复窦性心律，提示饮食性刺激物可作为SVT诱因。
AI.motivation: 青少年室上性心动过速（SVT）可由生理应激或咖啡因诱发，但临床对茶饮等含咖啡因饮食作为SVT诱因的认识不足，既往报告多集中于咖啡因摄入，茶饮相关诱因证据有限，易被漏诊或忽视。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为1例16岁女性术后患者，主诉饮茶后出现心悸、呼吸困难及规则性心动过速（170次/分）；记录心电图并予静脉腺苷复律，观察心律转复情况。摘要未报告更多样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 心电图证实为SVT，静脉注射腺苷后恢复窦性心律；摘要未报告腺苷剂量、复律时间、随访时长及复发次数等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示应将茶等含咖啡因饮食刺激物视为青少年SVT的潜在诱因，临床问诊中需详细采集饮食史；但作为单例报告，因果关联与普遍性有限，需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh: 青少年中的室上性心动过速（SVT）可能由生理性应激或咖啡因诱发。我们报告一名16岁女孩，她在饮茶后出现心悸、呼吸困难以及规则的心动过速（170次/分）。心电图显示SVT，静脉注射腺苷恢复了窦性心律。认识到膳食兴奋剂是SVT的潜在诱发因素很重要。

title: Blocking the Sympathetic Storm: Adjunctive Left Stellate Ganglion Block for Refractory Ventricular Tachycardia After Inferolateral Myocardial Infarction
summary: Electrical storm following myocardial infarction (MI) can be difficult to control when antiarrhythmic drugs and cardioversion fail.We describe a 53-year-old man with hypertension and previously undiagnosed diabetes who presented with an inferolateral ST-segment elevation MI caused by total occlusion of the proximal left circumflex artery, which was treated with primary percutaneous coronary intervention and drug-eluting stent placement.He then developed marked leukocytosis with a systemic inflammatory response and acute kidney injury (peak creatinine, 4.03 mg/dL), which resolved with empirical antibiotic therapy and supportive renal care.On day 6, he experienced recurrent syncope associated with sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia (VT) that persisted despite intravenous amiodarone and lidocaine, electrolyte correction, and repeated cardioversion, necessitating sedation and mechanical ventilation.Repeat coronary angiography demonstrated a patent stent.VT ceased following an ultrasound-guided left stellate ganglion block (SGB) using 1% lidocaine and dexamethasone, which resulted in Horner syndrome.Antiarrhythmic therapy was continued, and the patient was extubated within 24 hours.Speckle-tracking echocardiography demonstrated severely reduced lateral and anterior strain (global longitudinal strain, -12.0%).A patent stent in the culprit vessel and sustained monomorphic arrhythmia made a scar-related substrate the leading consideration.The close temporal association between the block and cessation of VT suggests that sympathetic blockade may have contributed to arrhythmia control, although the continuation of antiarrhythmic therapy precludes firm causal conclusions.Left SGB may serve as a rapid bridge to definitive treatment in patients with refractory electrical storm.

AI.tldr: 53岁下侧壁心梗后反复单形性室速电风暴患者，在药物与电复律无效后经超声引导左星状神经节阻滞，室速随即终止并出现Horner征，24小时内拔管。
AI.motivation: 心梗后电风暴在抗心律失常药物和电复律失败时处理困难，交感神经过度激活是重要机制，但左星状神经节阻滞（SGB）在此类难治性室速中的辅助价值缺乏充分临床证据，需要病例层面的实践参考。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。53岁男性，高血压及既往未诊断糖尿病，因左回旋支近段完全闭塞致下侧壁ST段抬高型心梗，行直接PCI并置入药物洗脱支架。术后出现明显白细胞增多伴全身炎症反应及急性肾损伤（肌酐峰值4.03 mg/dL），经经验性抗生素及支持治疗缓解。第6天出现反复晕厥伴持续单形性室速，静脉胺碘酮、利多卡因、电解质纠正及反复电复律均无效，需镇静和机械通气；复查冠脉造影示支架通畅。随后在超声引导下以1%利多卡因联合地塞米松行左SGB。观察终点为室速是否终止及围术期临床转归，另以斑点追踪超声评估心室应变。
AI.result: 左SGB后室速终止，并出现Horner综合征；继续抗心律失常药物治疗，24小时内成功拔管。斑点追踪超声示侧壁及前壁应变严重减低，整体纵向应变为-12.0%。复查造影示罪犯血管支架通畅。摘要未报告阻滞前后室速负荷、心率变化等定量数据，也未报告随访期心律失常复发情况。
AI.conclusion: 对于心梗后瘢痕相关难治性电风暴，左SGB可能作为快速过渡手段帮助控制室速，为后续确定性治疗争取时间。但本例同时继续使用抗心律失常药物，且为单例报告，无法确立因果关系，结论需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）后发生的电风暴在抗心律失常药物和心脏电复律失败时可能难以控制。我们描述了一名53岁男性，患有高血压和既往未诊断的糖尿病，因左回旋支近端完全闭塞导致下侧壁ST段抬高型心肌梗死，接受了直接经皮冠状动脉介入治疗和药物洗脱支架置入术。随后他出现了明显的白细胞增多伴全身炎症反应和急性肾损伤（峰值肌酐4.03 mg/dL），经经验性抗生素治疗和支持性肾脏护理后缓解。第6天，他出现反复晕厥，伴有持续性单形性室性心动过速（VT），尽管静脉给予胺碘酮和利多卡因、纠正电解质和反复心脏电复律，VT仍持续存在，需要镇静和机械通气。重复冠状动脉造影显示支架通畅。使用1%利多卡因和地塞米松进行超声引导下左侧星状神经节阻滞（SGB）后，VT停止，并出现了Horner综合征。继续抗心律失常治疗，患者在24小时内拔管。斑点追踪超声心动图显示侧壁和前壁应变严重减低（整体纵向应变，-12.0%）。罪犯血管支架通畅和持续性单形性心律失常使瘢痕相关基质成为首要考虑。阻滞与VT停止之间的密切时间关联提示交感神经阻滞可能有助于心律失常控制，尽管继续抗心律失常治疗使得无法得出明确的因果结论。左侧SGB可能作为难治性电风暴患者通向确定性治疗的快速桥接。

title: Stellate ganglion block for ventricular arrhythmia disease states: Emerging treatment options.
summary: Autonomic modulation has emerged as an effective therapeutic target in the management of ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (e.g., refractory ventricular arrhythmias), in a background of growing evidence of the link between the autonomic nervous system and arrhythmias. Stellate ganglion blockade (SGB) is a minimally invasive procedure targeting the stellate ganglion with an anesthetic agent that has emerged as a temporizing treatment option for management of refractory and hemodynamically unstable ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (ES). SGB which can be performed with fluoroscopy-guidance or at the bedside with anatomic landmark approach or ultrasound guidance, has shown potential efficacy in short-term reduction of arrhythmic burden and termination of electrical storm, based on data from case series and observational studies. In the current review, we highlight the role of the autonomic nervous system in arrhythmogenesis and the clinical applications as well as current limitations and future directions of SGB in management of ventricular arrhythmia and electrical storm.

AI.tldr: 星状神经节阻滞（SGB）作为微创自主神经调节手段，在病例系列和观察性研究中可短期减少室性心律失常负荷并终止电风暴，但缺乏随机对照证据。
AI.motivation: 自主神经系统与室性心律失常发生密切相关，自主神经调节已成为治疗靶点；对于难治性、血流动力学不稳定的室性心律失常及电风暴（ES），现有治疗手段有限，SGB 作为临时性治疗选择逐渐受到关注，但其临床应用价值、局限与未来方向尚需系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为综述，非原始研究，无样本量与终点定义。文章总结自主神经在心律失常发生中的作用，并综述 SGB 的临床证据：SGB 为微创操作，可经透视引导、床旁解剖标志法或超声引导实施，以麻醉药物阻滞星状神经节；证据来源为病例系列与观察性研究，摘要未报告具体统计方法与汇总效应量。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；仅定性指出基于病例系列和观察性研究的数据，SGB 在短期减少心律失常负荷和终止电风暴方面显示出潜在疗效。
AI.conclusion: SGB 是有前景的临时性自主神经调节治疗，可用于难治性室性心律失常与电风暴的短期控制，可能为后续确定性治疗争取时间；但现有证据仅来自病例系列与观察性研究，缺乏随机对照验证，疗效与安全性、最佳实施方式（透视、超声或解剖标志）及适应证尚待明确，需进一步前瞻性研究。

summary_zh: 自主神经调节已成为管理室性心律失常和电风暴（例如难治性室性心律失常）的有效治疗靶点，其背景是越来越多的证据表明自主神经系统与心律失常之间存在联系。星状神经节阻滞（SGB）是一种微创手术，使用麻醉剂靶向星状神经节，已成为管理难治性和血流动力学不稳定的室性心律失常和电风暴（ES）的临时治疗选择。根据病例系列和观察性研究的数据，SGB可以在透视引导下或在床旁通过解剖标志法或超声引导进行，已显示出在短期减少心律失常负荷和终止电风暴方面的潜在疗效。在本综述中，我们重点介绍自主神经系统在心律失常发生中的作用，以及SGB在管理室性心律失常和电风暴中的临床应用、当前局限性和未来方向。

title: Rapid Progression of Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy With Sudden Cardiac Death Within the First Year of Heart Transplantation: A Case Report.
summary: Cardiac allograft vasculopathy (CAV) is a major cause of mortality and morbidity within the first 3 years of heart transplantation (HT). CAV results in progressive coronary artery stenosis and may lead to arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death. In some cases, sudden cardiac death represents the initial presentation of CAV, as cardiac denervation blunts anginal symptoms that otherwise could have preceded sudden cardiac death (SCD). Here, we describe the case of a 56-year-old man with non-ischemic cardiomyopathy. He underwent left ventricular assist device implantation followed by orthotopic HT. Five months after transplantation, he presented with atypical mid-sternal chest discomfort initially thought to be musculoskeletal in origin. Routine coronary angiography at 12 months revealed severe, diffuse 3-vessel disease consistent with International Society of Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) CAV-3, and cardiac MRI revealed full thickness delayed enhancement in the inferior wall consistent with infarction. Despite overall preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, he developed polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (VT) with an appropriate shock from a wearable cardioverter-defibrillator (WCD) and was transferred with an intra-aortic balloon pump to a larger transplant center and underwent another heart transplantation. This case highlights rapid CAV progression leading to infarction and arrhythmia despite preserved LVEF, emphasizing the need for enhanced screening with biomarkers and imaging as well as earlier consideration for device-based strategies to prevent sudden cardiac death in high-risk transplant recipients.

AI.tldr: 56岁男性心脏移植后5个月出现非典型胸痛，12个月冠脉造影示ISHLT CAV-3弥漫三支病变，尽管LVEF保留仍发生多形性室速并接受WCD放电，提示CAV快速进展可致梗死和心律失常。
AI.motivation: 心脏移植后3年内CAV是主要死亡和并发症原因，可导致心律失常和猝死；由于心脏去神经化，心绞痛症状常缺如，猝死可能为首发表现，需提高对CAV快速进展及猝死风险的警惕。
AI.method: 病例报告：1例56岁男性非缺血性心肌病患者，先后接受左心室辅助装置植入和原位心脏移植；移植后5个月出现非典型胸骨中段不适，12个月行常规冠状动脉造影和心脏MRI，并监测心律失常事件。
AI.result: 移植后12个月冠脉造影显示符合ISHLT CAV-3的严重弥漫性三支病变，心脏MRI示下壁全层延迟强化提示梗死；尽管整体LVEF保留，患者发生多形性室性心动过速，可穿戴式心律转复除颤器（WCD）给予适当放电，随后经主动脉内球囊反搏支持转至 larger transplant center 并再次接受心脏移植。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示CAV可在LVEF保留的情况下快速进展至心肌梗死和恶性室性心律失常，临床意义在于对高危心脏移植受者需加强生物标志物和影像学筛查，并尽早考虑器械预防猝死；局限性为单例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏移植物血管病（CAV）是心脏移植（HT）后3年内死亡和发病的主要原因。CAV导致进行性冠状动脉狭窄，并可能导致心律失常和心源性猝死。在某些病例中，心源性猝死是CAV的首发表现，因为心脏去神经支配减弱了心绞痛症状，否则这些症状可能先于心源性猝死（SCD）出现。

方法：在此，我们描述了一例56岁非缺血性心肌病男性患者。他接受了左心室辅助装置植入，随后进行了原位心脏移植。移植后五个月，他出现非典型胸骨中段不适，最初被认为是肌肉骨骼源性。12个月时的常规冠状动脉造影显示严重的弥漫性三支血管病变，符合国际心肺移植学会（ISHLT）CAV-3，心脏MRI显示下壁全层延迟强化，符合梗死。尽管左心室射血分数总体保留，但他出现了多形性室性心动过速（VT），可穿戴式心脏复律除颤器（WCD）给予了适当电击，并随主动脉内球囊反搏转至更大的移植中心，接受了另一次心脏移植。

结论：本病例突出了尽管LVEF保留，CAV仍快速进展导致梗死和心律失常，强调需要加强生物标志物和影像学筛查，以及更早考虑基于设备的策略以预防高危移植受者的心源性猝死。

title: External validation of artificial intelligence-guided electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) in detecting asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
AIM: Asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) represents a key and frequently under-recognized stage in the heart failure (HF) continuum. Early identification enables targeted prevention and timely initiation of evidence-based therapies. Artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) may provide a scalable alternative to imaging for LVD detection. This systematic review synthesized evidence from exclusively externally validated AI-ECG studies evaluating the detection of asymptomatic LVD, with symptomatic HF cohorts included to contextualize the evidence base across the HF continuum.

METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted on 8th September 2025. The main output was the pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).

RESULTS: From 3,587 records, 12 asymptomatic and 30 symptomatic studies were identified (538,735 participants). In asymptomatic cohorts evaluating left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD), AI-ECG demonstrated promising but heterogeneous discriminatory performance (I²>85%) with pooled AUROCs of 0.87 (95% CI 0.75-0.99) for LVEF ≤35%, 0.93 (95% CI 0.88-0.97) for LVEF ≤40%, and 0.89 (95% CI 0.85-0.97) for LVEF ≤50%. Symptomatic cohorts showed AUROCs of 0.89 (95% CI 0.86-0.92), 0.90 (95% CI 0.88-0.92), and 0.85 (95% CI 0.83-0.86) respectively. Asymptomatic left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (LVDD) demonstrated moderate performance (AUROC 0.76, 95% CI 0.66-0.86) with no externally validated symptomatic LVDD studies identified. Small-study effects were detected exclusively in asymptomatic cohorts.

CONCLUSIONS: Discriminatory performance of AI-ECG in asymptomatic LVSD is broadly comparable to symptomatic populations. High risk of bias driven by prolonged ECG-to-echocardiogram intervals reflecting real-world logistical constraints necessitate cautious interpretation of results and further prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 在无症状左室收缩功能不全人群中，外部验证的AI-ECG检测LVEF≤40%的汇总AUROC达0.93，与有症状心衰人群表现相当，但异质性高、偏倚风险大。
AI.motivation: 无症状左室功能障碍是心衰连续病程中常被漏诊的关键阶段，早期识别可及时启动循证治疗；AI-ECG有望替代影像学实现可扩展筛查，但既往证据多来自内部验证，缺乏仅纳入外部验证研究的系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，2025年9月8日检索文献；仅纳入外部验证的AI-ECG检测左室功能障碍研究，并纳入有症状心衰队列以呈现心衰连续病程中的证据背景；主要终点为汇总AUROC，同时评估异质性与偏倚风险。
AI.result: 从3587条记录中纳入12项无症状研究和30项有症状研究，共538735名受试者。无症状LVSD队列中，AI-ECG检测LVEF≤35%、≤40%、≤50%的汇总AUROC分别为0.87（95%CI 0.75-0.99）、0.93（95%CI 0.88-0.97）、0.89（95%CI 0.85-0.97），异质性I²>85%；有症状队列相应为0.89（0.86-0.92）、0.90（0.88-0.92）、0.85（0.83-0.86）。无症状LVDD表现中等（AUROC 0.76，95%CI 0.66-0.86），未发现外部验证的有症状LVDD研究；小样本效应仅见于无症状队列。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG在无症状LVSD中的判别能力与有症状人群大致相当，支持其作为 scalable 筛查工具的潜力；但心电图至超声心动图间隔过长等现实限制导致高偏倚风险，结果需谨慎解读，尚需前瞻性外部验证。

summary_zh:
目的：无症状性左心室功能障碍（LVD）是心力衰竭（HF）连续病程中一个关键且常被低估的阶段。早期识别有助于针对性预防和及时启动循证治疗。人工智能心电图（AI-ECG）可能为LVD检测提供一种可扩展的影像学替代方案。本系统综述综合了仅来自外部验证的AI-ECG研究的证据，这些研究评估了无症状LVD的检测，并纳入有症状HF队列以在HF连续病程中提供证据背景。

方法：于2025年9月8日进行了系统性文献检索。主要输出为汇总的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。

结果：从3,587条记录中，识别出12项无症状研究和30项有症状研究（538,735名参与者）。在评估左心室收缩功能障碍（LVSD）的无症状队列中，AI-ECG表现出有前景但异质的判别性能（I²>85%），LVEF ≤35%的汇总AUROC为0.87（95% CI 0.75-0.99），LVEF ≤40%为0.93（95% CI 0.88-0.97），LVEF ≤50%为0.89（95% CI 0.85-0.97）。有症状队列的AUROC分别为0.89（95% CI 0.86-0.92）、0.90（95% CI 0.88-0.92）和0.85（95% CI 0.83-0.86）。无症状左心室舒张功能障碍（LVDD）表现出中等性能（AUROC 0.76，95% CI 0.66-0.86），未识别到外部验证的有症状LVDD研究。小样本效应仅见于无症状队列。

结论：AI-ECG在无症状LVSD中的判别性能与有症状人群大致相当。由于反映现实世界后勤限制的心电图至超声心动图间隔延长导致的高偏倚风险，需要对结果进行谨慎解读并进一步开展前瞻性验证。

title: Validation studies of ICD-10 diagnostic codes for identifying common causes of hospitalization: a scoping review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) diagnosis codes are widely used to identify clinical conditions in administrative health data for epidemiologic research, surveillance, and health services evaluation. However, the validity of ICD-10-coded diagnoses varies across conditions and healthcare settings, and validation studies differ substantially in design, case definitions, and reporting practices.

OBJECTIVE: To characterize validation studies of ICD-10-based case definitions for eight common causes of hospitalization and identify methodological factors affecting the interpretation and comparability of reported performance estimates.

DESIGN: PubMed and Embase (2005-2025) were searched for systematic reviews and primary studies validating ICD-10-coded diagnoses for the following conditions: heart failure, osteoarthritis, pneumonia, diabetes mellitus, acute myocardial infarction, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, acute kidney injury, and stroke. Data on study characteristics, case definitions, reference standards, and performance metrics were extracted and descriptively summarized.

RESULTS: We identified 116 unique primary publications through 11 systematic reviews and our database search. Stroke and heart failure had the largest evidence base, whereas few validation studies were identified for several conditions. More than one-third of studies reported only positive predictive value, typically reflecting a study design that verified algorithm-identified cases and therefore precluded estimation of sensitivity and specificity. When reported, specificity was generally high, whereas sensitivity varied considerably; however, differences in study design limited comparability of estimates. Incorporating laboratory results, procedures, medications, or other electronic health record data often improved the performance of ICD-10-based case definitions.

CONCLUSIONS: Validation studies of ICD-10-coded diagnoses are highly heterogeneous in design and reporting, limiting direct comparison across studies. Many rely on designs that only estimate positive predictive value and therefore provide incomplete assessments of validity. Standardized, population-based validation studies measuring both sensitivity and specificity are needed to improve the reliability and reproducibility of administrative health data for epidemiologic research, surveillance, and quality improvement.

AI.tldr: ICD-10诊断编码验证研究在设计、病例定义和报告上高度异质，多数仅报告阳性预测值，需标准化人群研究同时评估灵敏度和特异度。
AI.motivation: ICD-10诊断编码广泛用于行政健康数据以识别临床状况，但其有效性因疾病和医疗环境而异，且验证研究在设计、病例定义和报告实践上差异很大，限制了性能估计的可解释性和可比性。
AI.method: 范围综述，检索PubMed和Embase（2005-2025）中验证八种常见住院原因（心力衰竭、骨关节炎、肺炎、糖尿病、急性心肌梗死、慢性阻塞性肺疾病、急性肾损伤、卒中）ICD-10编码诊断的系统综述和原始研究，提取研究特征、病例定义、参考标准和性能指标并进行描述性总结。
AI.result: 通过11篇系统综述和数据库检索共纳入116篇原始文献。卒中和心力衰竭证据基础最大，部分疾病验证研究很少。超过三分之一的研究仅报告阳性预测值，通常因设计仅验证算法识别病例而无法估计灵敏度和特异度。报告特异度普遍较高，灵敏度变异较大，但研究设计差异限制估计可比性。结合实验室结果、操作、药物或其他电子健康记录数据常改善ICD-10病例定义性能。
AI.conclusion: ICD-10编码诊断验证研究设计和报告高度异质，限制跨研究直接比较；许多研究仅估计阳性预测值，提供不完整的有效性评估。需要标准化、基于人群的验证研究同时测量灵敏度和特异度，以提高行政健康数据在流行病学研究、监测和质量改进中的可靠性和可重复性。

summary_zh:
背景：国际疾病分类第十版（ICD-10）诊断编码被广泛用于在行政健康数据中识别临床状况，以进行流行病学研究、监测和卫生服务评价。然而，ICD-10编码诊断的有效性因疾病和医疗环境而异，且验证研究在设计、病例定义和报告规范方面存在显著差异。

目的：描述针对八种常见住院原因的ICD-10病例定义的验证研究特征，并识别影响所报告性能估计的解释和可比性的方法学因素。

设计：检索PubMed和Embase（2005-2025年）中验证以下疾病ICD-10编码诊断的系统综述和原始研究：心力衰竭、骨关节炎、肺炎、糖尿病、急性心肌梗死、慢性阻塞性肺疾病、急性肾损伤和卒中。提取研究特征、病例定义、参考标准和性能指标的数据并进行描述性总结。

结果：通过11篇系统综述和我们的数据库检索，共识别出116篇独特的原始文献。卒中和心力衰竭的证据基础最大，而若干疾病的验证研究较少。超过三分之一的研究仅报告阳性预测值，通常反映其研究设计仅验证算法识别的病例，因而无法估计灵敏度和特异度。当报告时，特异度通常较高，而灵敏度差异较大；然而，研究设计的差异限制了估计值的可比性。结合实验室结果、操作、药物或其他电子健康记录数据通常能提高ICD-10病例定义的性能。

结论：ICD-10编码诊断的验证研究在设计 and 报告方面高度异质，限制了研究间的直接比较。许多研究依赖仅估计阳性预测值的设计，因此提供的有效性评估不完整。需要标准化的、基于人群的验证研究，同时测量灵敏度和特异度，以提高行政健康数据在流行病学研究、监测和质量改进中的可靠性和可重复性。

title: ICD-Coded Versus Undiagnosed Acute Kidney Injury in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) Study.
summary:
RATIONALE & OBJECTIVE: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is common among older adults and associated with adverse outcomes, yet it often goes undiagnosed. We aimed to compare the prevalence of undiagnosed versus International Classification of Diseases (ICD)-coded AKI as well as their clinical and molecular characteristics and evaluate their associations with clinical outcomes.

STUDY DESIGN: Prospective cohort study.

SETTING & PARTICIPANTS: A total of 5,692 adults with proteomic and metabolomic profiling from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities study, excluding individuals with end-stage kidney disease at baseline (2011-2013).

EXPOSURES: AKI, defined as either ICD-coded or undiagnosed based on 3 abstracted levels of serum creatinine measured during hospitalizations.

OUTCOMES: Incident coronary heart disease, heart failure, stroke, and all-cause mortality.

ANALYTICAL APPROACH: ICD-coded AKI was compared with undiagnosed AKI across all hospitalizations. Risk factors for ICD-coded and undiagnosed AKI were assessed separately using Cox proportional hazards models from study visit to the first AKI encounter. Time-varying Cox models were used to evaluate the associations of ICD-coded and undiagnosed AKI with adverse outcomes.

RESULTS: ICD codes identified 51.4% of AKI defined based on changes in serum creatinine, with higher sensitivity for more severe stages and a specificity of 87.0%. Undiagnosed AKI was more common in women; otherwise, clinical risk factors for undiagnosed AKI were similar to those for ICD-coded AKI, as were proteomic and metabolomic risk factors. Both AKI groups were strongly associated with coronary heart disease, heart failure, stroke, and mortality.

LIMITATIONS: AKI was estimated using 3 values of serum creatinine only and not urinary output. Diagnosed AKI was identified using billing codes, which may underestimate clinical diagnosis of AKI.

CONCLUSIONS: Undiagnosed AKI is prevalent, especially among women, and is biologically and prognostically similar to ICD-coded AKI, motivating efforts to improve AKI recognition and diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 在ARIC队列中，ICD编码仅识别51.4%的基于肌酐的AKI，未诊断AKI在女性中更常见，且与ICD编码AKI具有相似的临床风险因素、蛋白质组和代谢组特征，并与冠心病、心衰、卒中和死亡强相关。
AI.motivation: 急性肾损伤（AKI）在老年人中常见且与不良结局相关，但常被漏诊。既往缺乏对未诊断AKI与ICD编码AKI的患病率、临床和分子特征及其与临床结局关联的系统比较。
AI.method: 前瞻性队列研究，纳入ARIC研究中5,692名具有蛋白质组和代谢组数据的成人（2011-2013年），排除基线终末期肾病患者。AKI定义为ICD编码或基于住院期间3次血清肌酐测定的未诊断AKI。终点为新发冠心病、心力衰竭、卒中和全因死亡。采用Cox比例风险模型评估风险因素，时变Cox模型评估AKI与结局的关联。
AI.result: ICD编码识别了51.4%的基于肌酐变化的AKI，对更严重分期敏感性更高，特异性87.0%。未诊断AKI在女性中更常见；除此之外，未诊断AKI的临床风险因素与ICD编码AKI相似，蛋白质组和代谢组风险因素也相似。两种AKI均与冠心病、心力衰竭、卒中和死亡强相关（具体效应量及95%CI摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: 未诊断AKI普遍存在，尤其在女性中，其生物学和预后特征与ICD编码AKI相似，提示需改进AKI的识别和诊断。局限性包括仅用3次肌酐值估算AKI且未使用尿量，以及诊断AKI依赖 billing codes 可能低估临床诊断。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：急性肾损伤（AKI）在老年人中常见，并与不良结局相关，但常常未被诊断。我们旨在比较未诊断的AKI与国际疾病分类（ICD）编码的AKI的患病率，以及它们的临床和分子特征，并评估它们与临床结局的关联。

研究设计：前瞻性队列研究。

设置与参与者：来自社区动脉粥样硬化风险研究的总共5,692名具有蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析的成年人，排除基线（2011-2013年）时患有终末期肾病的个体。

暴露：AKI，定义为ICD编码的或未诊断的，基于住院期间测量的3个抽象血清肌酐水平。

结局：新发冠心病、心力衰竭、卒中和全因死亡率。

分析方法：在所有住院中比较ICD编码的AKI与未诊断的AKI。使用Cox比例风险模型分别评估从研究访视到首次AKI事件期间ICD编码和未诊断AKI的风险因素。使用时变Cox模型评估ICD编码和未诊断AKI与不良结局的关联。

结果：ICD代码识别了基于血清肌酐变化的51.4%的AKI，对更严重阶段的敏感性更高，特异性为87.0%。未诊断的AKI在女性中更常见；除此之外，未诊断AKI的临床风险因素与ICD编码AKI的相似，蛋白质组学和代谢组学风险因素也相似。两组AKI均与冠心病、心力衰竭、卒中和死亡率强烈相关。

局限性：AKI仅使用3个血清肌酐值估算，未使用尿量。诊断的AKI使用账单代码识别，可能低估临床诊断的AKI。

结论：未诊断的AKI普遍存在，尤其是在女性中，并且在生物学和预后上与ICD编码的AKI相似，这促使努力改善AKI的识别和诊断。

title: Doxorubicin-induced Cardiotoxicity in Dogs: A Narrative Review.
summary: Doxorubicin, an anthracycline widely used in both human and veterinary oncology, is highly effective against a variety of malignancies in dogs, including lymphomas, sarcomas and carcinomas. Despite its efficacy, doxorubicin exposure can be associated with cardiotoxicity, which may present acutely or chronically, potentially leading to severe cardiac arrhythmia and congestive heart failure. Mechanisms underlying cardiotoxicity are multifactorial, including oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, DNA damage via topoisomerase IIβ, inflammation and dysregulated cell death pathways such as apoptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis. In dogs, known risk factors include higher cumulative dose, breed predisposition to idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy, and higher body weight. Cardiac biomarkers, electrocardiography, echocardiography and other advanced imaging techniques have been employed to detect cardiac changes that can be seen also in the absence of clinical signs. However, current evidence is predominantly derived from experimental and retrospective research, highlighting the need for large prospective clinical studies to strengthen recommendations for monitoring and prevention. A deeper understanding of doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in dogs is needed to identify factors influencing individual susceptibility, clarify the progression from subclinical damage to clinical cardiac dysfunction, and guide future research. Emerging approaches, including advanced echocardiography, microRNAs, proteomic biomarkers and pharmacokinetic modelling, may help improve early detection and guide more individualised dosing to minimise toxicity.

AI.tldr: 多柔比星在犬中可致急慢性心脏毒性，机制涉及氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍等，现有证据多来自实验和回顾性研究，亟需大型前瞻性临床研究。
AI.motivation: 多柔比星是犬肿瘤化疗常用药物，但其心脏毒性可导致严重心律失常和充血性心力衰竭，目前对犬心脏毒性的认识不足，缺乏大型前瞻性临床研究来指导监测和预防。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，总结多柔比星诱导犬心脏毒性的机制、风险因素、检测手段及研究方向，未报告系统检索策略或样本量。
AI.result: 心脏毒性机制包括氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、拓扑异构酶IIβ介导的DNA损伤、炎症及凋亡、焦亡、铁死亡等细胞死亡通路失调；风险因素包括高累积剂量、特发性扩张型心肌病品种易感和高体重；检测手段包括心脏生物标志物、心电图、超声心动图等；摘要未报告具体效应量或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 需深入理解犬多柔比星心脏毒性以识别个体易感因素、阐明亚临床损伤向临床心功能障碍的进展，先进超声心动图、microRNA、蛋白质组学生物标志物和药代动力学模型有望改善早期检测和个体化给药，但当前证据多来自实验和回顾性研究，需大型前瞻性临床研究强化监测和预防建议。

summary_zh: 多柔比星是一种在人类和兽医肿瘤学中广泛使用的蒽环类药物，对犬的多种恶性肿瘤（包括淋巴瘤、肉瘤和癌）具有高度疗效。尽管其疗效显著，但多柔比星暴露可能与心脏毒性相关，心脏毒性可表现为急性或慢性，可能导致严重的心律失常和充血性心力衰竭。心脏毒性的机制是多因素的，包括氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、通过拓扑异构酶IIβ导致的DNA损伤、炎症以及失调的细胞死亡通路如凋亡、焦亡和铁死亡。在犬中，已知的风险因素包括较高的累积剂量、特发性扩张型心肌病的品种易感性以及较高的体重。心脏生物标志物、心电图、超声心动图和其他先进成像技术已被用于检测心脏变化，这些变化也可能在无临床症状时出现。然而，当前证据主要来自实验性和回顾性研究，突显了需要大型前瞻性临床研究来加强监测和预防的建议。需要更深入地了解犬多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性，以识别影响个体易感性的因素，阐明从亚临床损伤到临床心脏功能障碍的进展，并指导未来研究。新兴方法，包括先进超声心动图、微小RNA、蛋白质组学生物标志物和药代动力学建模，可能有助于改善早期检测并指导更个体化的给药以最小化毒性。

Structured postmortem genetic counselling and testing in sudden unexplained death among young adults in the Netherlands: results and implications regarding hereditary risk.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Sudden unexplained death (SUD) in young adults may result from hereditary cardiovascular disorders that remain undetected even after conventional autopsy. Routine postmortem genetic testing may identify these disorders, improving determination of the cause of death while providing diagnostic and preventive opportunities for surviving blood relatives.

METHODS: Between September 2022 and October 2025, 100 cases of SUD in young adults in the Netherlands were investigated using the NODOV (Nader Onderzoek naar de DoodsOorzaak bij (jong)Volwassenen) procedure. Genetic counselling was offered to surviving blood relatives in 50 cases where conventional autopsy findings suggested an inherited cardiovascular disorder. Conventional autopsy findings, medical history and family history guided phenotype-directed genetic testing using targeted gene panel analysis following whole-exome/genome sequencing.

RESULTS: Genetic testing was successfully performed in 46 out of 50 cases and identified pathogenic variants in six cases involving the CACNA1C, BAG3, MYBPC3, LDL-R, KCNJ2, and PKD1 genes. Pretest genetic counselling proved important in guiding genetic testing in 10% of all cases and 50% of genetically confirmed cases. Pathogenic variants were identified in both structurally abnormal and autopsy-negative cases. Families received tailored genetic counselling and recommendations for clinical follow-up based on predictive genetic testing. Among the 44 families without a genetic diagnosis, 43 were advised to undergo clinical cardiovascular screening.

CONCLUSION: This study highlights the importance of a structured multidisciplinary postmortem investigation, such as the NODOV procedure, integrating pretest genetic counselling and tailored postmortem genetic testing. This approach may improve determination of cause of death (particularly in autopsy-negative cases), aid in the identification of hereditary cardiovascular disorders and facilitate preventive strategies for at-risk blood relatives.

AI.tldr: 荷兰年轻成人不明原因猝死中，结构化尸检后基因检测在46例中检出6例致病变异，支持对存活亲属进行遗传评估与筛查。
AI.motivation: 年轻成人不明原因猝死可能由常规尸检无法识别的遗传性心血管疾病导致，尸检后基因检测有望明确死因并为存活血亲提供诊断和预防机会，但结构化流程的实施效果尚需验证。
AI.method: 2022年9月至2025年10月在荷兰开展的前瞻性队列研究，纳入100例年轻成人不明原因猝死病例，采用NODOV流程；对50例常规尸检提示遗传性心血管病的病例，向存活血亲提供遗传咨询，结合尸检、病史和家族史指导表型导向的靶向基因panel检测（基于全外显子/基因组测序）。
AI.result: 50例中46例成功完成基因检测，6例检出致病变异，涉及CACNA1C、BAG3、MYBPC3、LDL-R、KCNJ2和PKD1基因；检测前遗传咨询在全部病例的10%和遗传确诊者的50%中起重要指导作用；致病变异在结构异常和尸检阴性病例中均被发现；44个无遗传诊断的家庭中43个被建议进行临床心血管筛查。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多学科尸检后调查（如NODOV流程）整合检测前遗传咨询和定制基因检测，可提高死因判定（尤其尸检阴性病例）、识别遗传性心血管病并促进高危血亲的预防策略；但样本量有限，需更大规模研究验证。

引言：年轻成人的不明原因猝死（SUD）可能源于遗传性心血管疾病，这些疾病即使在常规尸检后仍未被发现。常规尸检后基因检测可能识别这些疾病，改善死因判定，同时为存活的血缘亲属提供诊断和预防机会。

方法：2022年9月至2025年10月期间，荷兰采用NODOV（Nader Onderzoek naar de DoodsOorzaak bij (jong)Volwassenen）流程调查了100例年轻成人SUD病例。在50例常规尸检发现提示遗传性心血管疾病的病例中，向存活的血缘亲属提供了遗传咨询。常规尸检发现、病史和家族史指导了表型导向的基因检测，采用靶向基因面板分析，基于全外显子组/基因组测序。

title: Optogenetic cardioversion: To depolarize or to hyperpolarize?
Channelrhodopsin ion selectivity determines mechanisms and efficacy of optogenetic defibrillation in human atria and ventricles.
summary: Cardiac re-entrant arrhythmias are a major cause of sudden cardiac death. Optogenetic defibrillation has emerged as a promising anti-arrhythmic strategy based on photoactivation of channelrhodopsins, yet the efficacy and potential adverse consequences of activating different classes of light-gated ion channels have not been systematically evaluated. Previous studies assessed either cation (e.g. ChR2) or anion (e.g. GtACR1) non-selective channels, both of which depolarize resting cardiomyocytes. Recently identified light-gated K+ channels (e.g. WiChR) suppress cardiomyocyte activity while maintaining the membrane potential near its resting state, but their defibrillation potential remains unexplored. We used computational simulations to compare ChR2, GtACR1 and WiChR. Single-cell simulations showed that ChR2 and GtACR1 markedly increased diastolic intracellular Ca2+ (by 42.6% and 52.6%, respectively), whereas WiChR induced only minimal changes (by 4.0%), suggesting lower pro-arrhythmogenic risk. WiChR, however, slightly increased intracellular Na+ (by 15.1% vs. 0.1% and 3.4% for ChR2 and GtACR1), consistent with the residual Na+ permeability of currently available K+-conducting channelrhodopsins. Simulations in human ventricles and atria showed that GtACR1 most effectively terminated re-entrant arrhythmias at low light intensities, whereas WiChR achieved comparable efficacy at ≥5 mW/mm2. Complementary tissue-scale simulations revealed that defibrillation occurs through depolarization within the excitable gap followed by fast Na+ channel inactivation (ChR2 and partly GtACR1), or through reduced membrane resistance at sufficiently high light intensities (large-conductance channels GtACR1 and WiChR). Overall, we demonstrate that channelrhodopsin ion selectivity is a key determinant of both optogenetic defibrillation efficacy and its underlying mechanisms. TRANSLATIONAL PERSPECTIVE: Re-entrant arrhythmias are a leading cause of sudden cardiac death. Standard therapies, including the activation of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, carry burdens such as pain and myocardial injury. Optogenetic defibrillation has been suggested as a potentially gentler alternative, replacing high-voltage electrical shocks by photoactivation of light-gated ion channels expressed in cardiac cells. Determining which light-gated ion channel optimally balances efficacy and adverse effects on cardiac electrophysiology is critical for clinical translation. We addressed this question using computational simulations and validation experiments in zebrafish hearts. We identify ion selectivity as a key determinant of both the success rate for arrhythmia termination and the underlying mechanisms: non-selective cation- and anion-conducting channels terminate re-entry efficiently while promoting intracellular Ca2+ accumulation, a plausible substrate for pro-arrhythmic side effects that could undermine therapeutic safety. K+-conducting channels largely avoid this pro-arrhythmic risk by holding cardiomyocytes near their resting potential, albeit at the cost of requiring transmural illumination, while also causing mild Na+ accumulation attributable to residual Na+ permeability. Together, these trade-offs define clear clinical implications: K+-conducting channels may provide the safest option for optogenetic defibrillation, particularly once variants with further enhanced K+ selectivity and red-shifted activation spectra for improved operation within blood-perfused myocardium become available. KEY POINTS: We use computational simulations to compare cation non-selective (ChR2), anion non-selective (GtACR1) and K+-selective (WiChR) channelrhodopsins for optogenetic termination of re-entrant arrhythmia. Single-cardiomyocyte simulations suggest that ChR2 and GtACR1 activation can cause progressive accumulation of intracellular Ca2+, which is minimized when using WiChR. Intracellular microelectrode recordings from hearts of transgenic adult zebrafish validate the simulated voltage dynamics seen with ChR2, GtACR1 or WiChR activation. Simulations of human left ventricles and atria indicate that GtACR1 is most effective in terminating re-entrant arrhythmia at low light intensities, whereas WiChR becomes similarly effective at higher intensities. Tissue-scale simulations indicate distinct defibrillation mechanisms: excitable gap extinction by de novo action potential initiation followed by inactivation of fast Na+ channels for depolarizing channelrhodopsins (ChR2, GtACR1), and reduction in membrane resistance for the large-conductance channels (GtACR1, WiChR), effectively clamping the membrane potential at each channel's reversal potential at high light levels.

AI.tldr: 计算模拟比较ChR2、GtACR1和WiChR的光遗传除颤效果，发现GtACR1在低光强下最有效，WiChR在高光强下效果相当且钙超载风险更低，离子选择性决定除颤机制与安全性。
AI.motivation: 折返性心律失常是心源性猝死的主要原因，光遗传除颤通过光激活通道视紫红质有望替代高电压电击，但不同离子选择性通道的除颤疗效和不良反应尚未系统评估，尤其是新型光门控K+通道（WiChR）的除颤潜力未知。
AI.method: 采用计算模拟研究，比较阳离子非选择性通道ChR2、阴离子非选择性通道GtACR1和K+选择性通道WiChR。进行单细胞模拟评估细胞内Ca2+和Na+变化，并在人类心室和心房组织尺度模拟中评估折返性心律失常终止效果和机制，辅以转基因斑马鱼心脏细胞内微电极记录验证电压动态。
AI.result: 单细胞模拟显示ChR2和GtACR1分别使舒张期细胞内Ca2+增加42.6%和52.6%，WiChR仅增加4.0%；WiChR使细胞内Na+增加15.1%，而ChR2和GtACR1分别增加0.1%和3.4%。人类心室和心房模拟中，GtACR1在低光强下最有效终止折返，WiChR在≥5 mW/mm2时光强下效果相当。组织尺度模拟揭示除颤机制：ChR2和部分GtACR1通过可兴奋间隙内去极化后快Na+通道失活，GtACR1和WiChR在高光强下通过降低膜电阻。
AI.conclusion: 通道视紫红质的离子选择性是光遗传除颤疗效和机制的关键决定因素。K+选择性通道WiChR在保持除颤效果的同时显著减少钙超载相关致心律失常风险，但需较高光强且存在轻度钠累积，未来需开发K+选择性更高和红移激活的变体以优化临床转化。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏折返性心律失常是心源性猝死的主要原因。光遗传学除颤作为一种基于通道视紫红质光激活的有前景的抗心律失常策略已经出现，但激活不同类别光门控离子通道的疗效和潜在不良后果尚未被系统评估。既往研究评估了阳离子（如ChR2）或阴离子（如GtACR1）非选择性通道，两者均使静息心肌细胞去极化。最近发现的光门控K+通道（如WiChR）抑制心肌细胞活动同时维持膜电位接近其静息状态，但其除颤潜力仍未被探索。我们使用计算模拟来比较ChR2、GtACR1和WiChR。

单细胞模拟显示ChR2和GtACR1显著增加舒张期细胞内Ca2+（分别增加42.6%和52.6%），而WiChR仅诱导极小变化（增加4.0%），提示较低的致心律失常风险。然而，WiChR轻微增加细胞内Na+（增加15.1%，而ChR2和GtACR1分别为0.1%和3.4%），这与当前可用的K+传导通道视紫红质的残余Na+通透性一致。

在人心室和心房的模拟显示，GtACR1在低光强度下最有效地终止折返性心律失常，而WiChR在≥5 mW/mm2时达到相当疗效。补充的组织尺度模拟揭示，除颤通过可兴奋间隙内去极化随后快速Na+通道失活（ChR2和部分GtACR1），或通过在足够高光强度下降低膜电阻（大电导通道GtACR1和WiChR）发生。

总体而言，我们证明通道视紫红质的离子选择性是光遗传学除颤疗效及其潜在机制的关键决定因素。

转化视角：折返性心律失常是心源性猝死的主要原因。标准疗法，包括激活植入式心律转复除颤器，带来疼痛和心肌损伤等负担。光遗传学除颤已被提出作为一种潜在更温和的替代方案，通过光激活心脏细胞中表达的光门控离子通道来替代高压电击。确定哪种光门控离子通道最佳平衡疗效和对心脏电生理的不良影响对于临床转化至关重要。我们使用计算模拟和斑马鱼心脏的验证实验来解决这个问题。我们确定离子选择性是心律失常终止成功率和潜在机制的关键决定因素：非选择性阳离子和阴离子传导通道有效终止折返同时促进细胞内Ca2+积累，这是可能削弱治疗安全性的致心律失常副作用的一个合理基础。K+传导通道通过将心肌细胞保持在接近其静息电位 largely 避免这种致心律失常风险，尽管代价是需要透壁照明，同时由于残余Na+通透性也引起轻度Na+积累。总之，这些权衡定义了明确的临床意义：K+传导通道可能为光遗传学除颤提供最安全的选择，特别是一旦具有进一步增强K+选择性和红移激活光谱以改善在血液灌注心肌内操作的变体可用时。

关键点：我们使用计算模拟来比较阳离子非选择性（ChR2）、阴离子非选择性（GtACR1）和K+选择性（WiChR）通道视紫红质用于光遗传学终止折返性心律失常。单心肌细胞模拟表明ChR2和GtACR1激活可引起细胞内Ca2+的进行性积累，而使用WiChR时最小化。来自转基因成年斑马鱼心脏的细胞内微电极记录验证了ChR2、GtACR1或WiChR激活时观察到的模拟电压动态。人左心室和心房的模拟表明GtACR1在低光强度下最有效终止折返性心律失常，而WiChR在较高强度下变得同样有效。组织尺度模拟表明不同的除颤机制：对于去极化通道视紫红质（ChR2、GtACR1），通过从头动作电位起始随后快速Na+通道失活来消除可兴奋间隙；对于大电导通道（GtACR1、WiChR），通过降低膜电阻，在高光水平下有效地将膜电位钳制在每个通道的反转电位。

title: Pathogenic Variants in NKX2-5 Associated With Familial Atrial Septal Defect and Conduction System Disease.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Most atrial septal defects (ASDs) occur sporadically, but familial cases can occur and carry a 10% risk of transmission to offspring.

CASE SUMMARY: We describe a 3-generation family with autosomal dominant secundum ASD and conduction system disease related to a novel NKX2-5 variant (c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs∗75). The index patient, a 58-year-old woman with prior ASD repair and mitral valve replacement, presented with chronotropic incompetence, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and prolonged pauses, leading to pacemaker implantation. Her mother had an ASD, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and pulmonary arterial hypertension. The proband's daughter also had an ASD. Genetic testing revealed a novel NKX2-5 pathogenic variant in all 3 patients.

REVIEW SUMMARY: The combination of an ASD and conduction system disease represents the most common phenotype in patients with pathogenic NKX2-5 variants.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: A thorough family history and genetic testing are needed when evaluating patients with ASD and concurrent conduction system abnormalities.

AI.tldr: 一个三代家系中，新型NKX2-5致病性变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75）与常染色体显性遗传的房间隔缺损及传导系统疾病共分离。
AI.motivation: 多数房间隔缺损（ASD）为散发性，但家族性病例存在，且向后代传递的风险约为10%。NKX2-5变异已知与ASD和传导系统疾病相关，但具体基因型-表型关系仍需更多家系证据。
AI.method: 病例报告。描述一个三代家系，先证者为58岁女性，既往ASD修补及二尖瓣置换，表现为变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞及长间歇，需植入起搏器；其母亲有ASD、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞及肺动脉高压；先证者女儿也有ASD。对3例患者进行基因检测。
AI.result: 基因检测显示3例患者均携带新型NKX2-5致病性变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75），呈常染色体显性遗传。摘要未报告具体统计量或效应值。
AI.conclusion: ASD合并传导系统疾病是NKX2-5致病性变异患者最常见的表型。临床评估ASD合并传导异常时，应详细采集家族史并进行基因检测。本报告为个案家系，结论需更大样本验证。

背景：大多数房间隔缺损（ASD）为散发性，但家族性病例也可发生，并且有10%的风险遗传给子代。

病例摘要：我们描述了一个三代家族，该家族患有常染色体显性继发孔型ASD和传导系统疾病，与一种新的NKX2-5变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs∗75）相关。先证患者为一名58岁女性，既往有ASD修补术和二尖瓣置换术史，因变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和长间歇就诊，并植入起搏器。她的母亲患有ASD、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和肺动脉高压。先证者的女儿也患有ASD。基因检测显示，所有3例患者均携带一种新的NKX2-5致病性变异。

要点信息：在评估ASD合并传导系统异常的患者时，需要进行详细的家族史调查和基因检测。

title: A hybrid quantum algorithm for multi-resolution arrhythmia classification
summary: Hybrid quantum algorithms for ECG image-based arrhythmia detection are increasingly used, but their performance under lower resolutions and varied training initialisations remains unclear. This study evaluates a hybrid quantum algorithm combining a fully fine-tuned ResNet50 backbone with a 10-qubit variational quantum circuit for six-class ECG arrhythmia classification. The algorithm was assessed on 24,799 held-out ECG images at controlled content resolutions of 80, 112, 160, 224 and 320 pixels and compared with a conventional ResNet50 classifier and a closely parameter-matched classical 10-dimensional bottleneck. At 224 and 320 pixels, all three approaches reached ceiling-level classification performance. Differences became more apparent as spatial information was reduced. At 112 pixels, evaluation across three independent training seeds produced a mean accuracy of 0.9690 ± 0.0124 for the hybrid quantum algorithm, compared with 0.9396 ± 0.0044 for ResNet50 and 0.9580 ± 0.0354 for the classical bottleneck. Corresponding macro-F1 scores were 0.8638 ± 0.0417, 0.8235 ± 0.0062 and 0.8783 ± 0.1033, respectively. Although the hybrid algorithm achieved the highest mean accuracy, the relative performance of the hybrid and classical bottleneck architectures varied across training seeds, indicating sensitivity to optimisation randomness. At 160 pixels, the architectures approached ceiling performance, while at 80 pixels the hybrid algorithm and ResNet50 showed comparable classification behaviour. These findings indicate that the quantum pathway does not provide a consistent classification advantage across resolutions or random initialisations, but remains competitive under moderate spatial-information reduction. Without patient identifiers or external validation, results reflect image-level benchmark performance. Broader generalisability requires patient-independent and external validation.

AI.tldr: 混合量子算法在112像素低分辨率下ECG心律失常六分类平均准确率0.9690，优于ResNet50的0.9396，但优势随分辨率与随机种子变化不一致。
AI.motivation: 基于ECG图像的混合量子算法用于心律失常检测日益增多，但其在较低分辨率和不同训练初始化下的性能尚不明确，缺乏与经典模型的系统比较。
AI.method: 研究评估结合全微调ResNet50骨干与10量子比特变分量子电路的混合量子算法，进行六类ECG心律失常分类。在24,799张留出ECG图像上，控制内容分辨率为80、112、160、224和320像素，与常规ResNet50分类器及参数匹配的经典10维瓶颈模型比较。主要终点为分类准确率，次要终点包括宏F1分数，并在112像素下用三个独立训练种子评估稳定性。
AI.result: 在224和320像素下，三种方法均达 ceiling 水平。112像素下，混合量子算法平均准确率0.9690±0.0124，ResNet50为0.9396±0.0044，经典瓶颈为0.9580±0.0354；宏F1分别为0.8638±0.0417、0.8235±0.0062和0.8783±0.1033。混合算法平均准确率最高，但其与经典瓶颈的相对性能随训练种子变化，提示对优化随机性敏感。160像素下各架构接近 ceiling，80像素下混合算法与ResNet50分类行为相当。
AI.conclusion: 量子通路在不同分辨率和随机初始化下未提供一致的分类优势，但在中等空间信息减少时仍具竞争力。结果仅为图像级基准性能，缺乏患者标识符或外部验证，广泛泛化需患者独立及外部验证。

summary_zh: 基于ECG图像的心律失常检测中，混合量子算法的应用日益增多，但其在较低分辨率和不同训练初始化下的性能仍不清楚。本研究评估了一种混合量子算法，该算法将完全微调的ResNet50骨干网络与一个10量子比特的变分量子电路相结合，用于六类ECG心律失常分类。该算法在24,799张留出的ECG图像上进行了评估，控制内容分辨率分别为80、112、160、224和320像素，并与传统ResNet50分类器以及参数密切匹配的经典10维瓶颈进行了比较。在224和320像素下，三种方法均达到天花板级别的分类性能。随着空间信息减少，差异变得更加明显。在112像素下，跨三个独立训练种子的评估显示，混合量子算法的平均准确率为0.9690 ± 0.0124，而ResNet50为0.9396 ± 0.0044，经典瓶颈为0.9580 ± 0.0354。相应的宏F1分数分别为0.8638 ± 0.0417、0.8235 ± 0.0062和0.8783 ± 0.1033。尽管混合算法达到了最高的平均准确率，但混合架构和经典瓶颈架构的相对性能在不同训练种子间存在差异，表明对优化随机性的敏感性。在160像素下，各架构接近天花板性能，而在80像素下，混合算法和ResNet50表现出可比的分类行为。这些发现表明，量子路径在不同分辨率或随机初始化下并未提供一致的分类优势，但在中等空间信息减少下仍具有竞争力。在没有患者标识符或外部验证的情况下，结果反映了图像级别的基准性能。更广泛的普适性需要患者独立和外部验证。
